name: FFS_ACTIVITY
description: Contains all activities except shift/mass/repeating ones.

columns.name: ARCH_DATE
columns.description: DB record partitioning date. Set automatically by DB Optimization job.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the activity in Oracle Field Service.

columns.name: ROUTE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the route this activity belongs to.

columns.name: MASTER_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a segmentable activity. It is available for activities that are segments of a segmentable activity which has the recordType=multiday_activity_segment. This field is not set for regular activities.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the repeating/mass/shift activity this record belongs to.

columns.name: TEAM_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Activity Team holder resource reference. Used for teamwork activities.

columns.name: VISIT_ID
columns.description: Activity Reference to Visit. Used when activites are combined to visits.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier of the activity in the origin system. The value can be empty.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE
columns.description: Activity type . The following values are allowed: 'regular', 'reopened', 'prework', 'multiday_activity', 'multiday_activity_segment'.

columns.name: TYPE_ID
columns.description: Reference to Activity Work Type List.

columns.name: WORK_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Activity work zone reference . It is a read-only field that is automatically assigned to an activity, based on the company setting 'work zone key' and the activity properties.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Activity Status. As a technician works through the activity, the status changes. The actions that are available for an activity are based on this status. Allowed Values: 'cancelled', 'completed', 'suspended', 'started', 'enroute', 'pending', 'notdone'.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: Estimated activity duration in minutes. Fills with actual duration after activity start.

columns.name: ETA
columns.description: Predicted or the actual activity start time. The time is displayed in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is assigned, ETA Time. Can be empty for regular and reopen appointments if status is pending or suspended. For started and ended - time when appointment is started. For cancelled can be empty or set, If set - it is time when provider started appointment before it was.

columns.name: TIME_DELIVERED_START
columns.description: Start time of the technician's arrival interval as communicated to the customer. The value is used by routing optimization engine to reduce changes to arrival time, so it is important to keep the value actual.

columns.name: TIME_DELIVERED_END
columns.description: End time of the technician's arrival interval as communicated to the customer. The value is used by routing optimization engine to reduce changes to arrival time, so it is important to keep the value actual.

columns.name: TIME_SLOT_ID
columns.description: Reference To The time slot during which the activity is completed. The time slot also indicates the service window for the activity. This time is displayed in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is assigned.

columns.name: SERVICE_WINDOW_START
columns.description: Activity Service window start time. Service window is returned in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is currently assigned.

columns.name: SERVICE_WINDOW_END
columns.description: Activity Service window end time. Service window is returned in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is currently assigned.

columns.name: DELIVERY_WINDOW_START
columns.description: Activity delivery window start time. The time is displayed in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is assigned.

columns.name: DELIVERY_WINDOW_END
columns.description: Activity delivery window end time. The time is displayed in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is assigned.

columns.name: TRAVEL_TIME
columns.description: Estimated time taken to travel to this activity. For activities that were started (status is 'started', 'completed', 'notdone') this parameter indicates reported travelling time, which is calculated based on the actual times.

columns.name: TRAVEL_ESTIMATION_METHOD
columns.description: Travel estimation method. It is a read-only field. The following values are returned: Airline Distance , Airline Distance and Statistics, External Adjustment,Manual Adjustment,Not Estimated,Point to Point,Same Location,Statistics,Street Level Routing,Travel key based Airline Distance,Using Defaults.

columns.name: TRAVEL_FROM_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Previous Activity identifier. Used only for travel adjustment process.

columns.name: CONTINUOUS_TRAVELING_TIME
columns.description: Time of travel between activities/locations with addresses/coordinates.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Activity Name of the customer. Maximum field length is 420. Encrypted.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NUMBER
columns.description: Activity account number of the customer. This field is used by integrations as a placeholder for the external identifier of the Account ID in the application. This parameter has no business significance in Oracle Field Service and can be left empty. Maximum field length is 40.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PHONE
columns.description: Activity regular (land) phone number of the customer. Encrypted.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_EMAIL
columns.description: Activity email address of the customer. Maximum field length is 320.Encrypted.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CELL
columns.description: Activity cell phone number of the customer. Encrypted.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Deprecated. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: STREET_ADDRESS
columns.description: Activity street address of the customer. This field is used for geocoding and must contain a valid address. Maximum field length is 240. Encrypted.

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: Activity city of the customer where the activity is scheduled. Maximum field length is 60.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Activity ZIP code of the customer where the activity is scheduled.

columns.name: STATE_PROVINCE
columns.description: Activity state of the customer where the activity is scheduled. Maximum field length is 60.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_ID
columns.description: Activity language. Reference to Language.Lid.

columns.name: REMINDER_TIME
columns.description: Number of minutes before the activity start time the customer must be notified of the activity.

columns.name: TIME_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Activity Time Zone. Reference to Time_Zone.Zid.

columns.name: DIFF
columns.description: Activity Time Zone Difference. Filled automatically based on selected time_zone_id.

columns.name: UPDATE_FLAGS
columns.description: Activity Type features. Filled automatically after Activity Type selection.

columns.name: COORD_STATUS
columns.description: Activity coordinates found staues: 'Is Found', 'Not_Found'.

columns.name: COORD_ACCURACY
columns.description: Activity accuracy Level Of Geocoding Coordinates Not Valid - -1 Undefined - 0 Country - 1 State - 2 County - 3 City - 4 Zip - 5 Route - 6 Street - 7 Intersection - 8 Address - 9.

columns.name: COORD_X
columns.description: Geographic coordinates that specify the location of the activity.

columns.name: COORD_Y
columns.description: Geographic coordinates that specify the location of the activity.

columns.name: SLA_START
columns.description: Time when the service level agreement (SLA) window starts. SLA window is returned in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is currently assigned.

columns.name: SLA_END
columns.description: Time when the service level agreement (SLA) window ends. The time is displayed in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format. SLA window is returned in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is currently assigned.

columns.name: FEATURES
columns.description: It is a bitmask field that defines active features for this activity. This value is copied from a selected activity type on create/update actions.

columns.name: POINTS
columns.description: The cost of the activity in 'points'. This field is intended for use by the Routing module.

columns.name: COMPLIANCE
columns.description: Bit-Mask that represents Activity compliance parameters (Compliance_* Constants).

columns.name: TIME_OF_BOOKING
columns.description: Time when the customer booked the activity. The time is displayed in the time zone of the customer.

columns.name: TIME_OF_ASSIGNMENT
columns.description: Time when the activity is assigned to the technician. This time is displayed in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is assigned.

columns.name: AUTO_ROUTED_TO_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Resource This Activity Was Assigned To During The Latest Routing Run.

columns.name: AUTO_ROUTED_TO_DATE
columns.description: Date This Activity Was Scheduled For During The Latest Routing Run.

columns.name: FIRST_MANUAL_OPER
columns.description: Name Of The First Manual Reschedule/Move/Reorder Operation Performed After An Automatic One.

columns.name: FIRST_MANUAL_OPER_USER_ID
columns.description: Identifier Of user who performed the first manual reschedule/Move/Reorder operation after an automatic one.

columns.name: FIRST_MANUAL_OPER_INTERFACE
columns.description: Interface The First Manual Reschedule/Move/Reorder Operation Was Performed From After An Automatic One.

columns.name: ACCESS_HOURS
columns.description: Activity access hours.It is generally not possible to work beyond the access hours.

columns.name: ACCESS_SCHEDULE
columns.description: The schedule (that is, the set of time intervals or access hours, two intervals per week day) when the asset or the activity location is accessible. Work must start and complete during this interval. It is generally not possible to work beyond the access hours. Maximum field length is 1020.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_FLOW_ID
columns.description: Reference to identifier of a flow that will be used to guide activity processing.

columns.name: SVC_WO_ID
columns.description: Identifier Of Fusion Service Work Order the Activity is linked to. Optional Field. Reference To Svc_Work_Orders.Wo_Id In Fusion.

columns.name: WIE_WO_ID
columns.description: Identifier Of Maintenance Work Order the activity Is linked to. Optional Field. Reference to Wie_Work_Orders_B.Work_Order_Id In Fusion.

columns.name: WIE_WO_OPERATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier Of Maintenance Work Order Operation the activity is linked to. Optional Field. Reference to Wie_Wo_Operations_B.Wo_Operation_Id In Fusion.

columns.name: IB_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier Of installed based asset the activity is linked to. Optional Field. Reference To Cse_Assets_B.Asset_Id In Fusion.

columns.name: PJF_PROJECT_ID
columns.description: Identifier Of project the Activity is linked to. Optional Field. Reference to Pjf_Projects_All_B.Project_Id In Fusion.

columns.name: PJF_PROJ_ELEMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of project task the activity is linked to. Optional Field. Reference To Pjf_Proj_Elements_B.Proj_Element_Id In Fusion.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: WMT_TOKEN
columns.description: Generated unique 8-symbol base62 string (ShUT), unique key to activity for the end customer.

columns.name: WMT_THEME_ID
columns.description: WMT theme (by id) which displays the activity to an end customer.

columns.name: WMT_LINK_CREATED_DATE
columns.description: Date/time when the WMT_TOKEN has been generated.

columns.name: WMT_LINK_OPENED_DATE
columns.description: Date/time when the WMT_TOKEN has been opened for the first time by the customer.

columns.name: WMT_SERVICE_RATING
columns.description: Numeric feedback (1-5) from the end customer, null by default.

columns.name: WMT_SERVICE_COMMENT
columns.description: Feedback text from the end customer, null by default.

columns.name: WMT_FEEDBACK_DATE
columns.description: Date/time when a WMT_SERVICE_RATING and/or WMT_SERVICE_RATING were provided by the end customer.

columns.name: COORD_VIEWPORT_RADIUS
columns.description: Radius of activity location viewport returned by geoprovider in meters.
